title: The name

posts.caption:
Daur means a new turn. Here is the one we are taking.

دور means an era, a new turn, a full round. Men's leather shoes have long been made in Pakistani workshops. The new turn is buying them without paying for someone else's logo and markup.

DAUR Supply sells men's leather shoes and sneakers at factory price, with Cash on Delivery across Pakistan. The first drop is on its way.

Follow @daursupply so Drop 01 reaches you first.
